versions.content: If acknowledgement is enabled for a provided VariableDataPrototype and a DataSendCompletedEvent refer- ences a runnable entity as well as the VariableAccess which in turn references the VariableDataPrototype , the runnable entity shall be activated when the transmission acknowledgement occurs or when a timeout was detected by the RTE. [SWS_Rte_01137].
